cues.en: And in this code challenge, you will learn about the glue function and that is the non-linear foundation of LMS.
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰，會學到 GELU，LLM 的非線性基礎。

cues.en: Also in this code challenge you will learn about PyTorch classes and functions.

cues.en: You'll learn about CPU and GPU and you'll learn about the challenges of clocking computation time.

cues.en: Now, before getting to the exercises, let me give you a little bit of background.

cues.zh: 如果線性層之間沒有非線性，深度學習模型就不會太厲害。

cues.en: Here's a question.

cues.en: If the glue function really is better than ReLU for deep learning, why is ReLU still so commonly used almost everywhere in deep learning except for language models?
cues.zh: 如果 GELU 真的比 ReLU 更適合深度學習，為什麼除了語言模型，其他領域仍普遍用 ReLU？

cues.en: Well, that's a great question.
cues.zh: 問得好。

cues.en: There are multiple answers to this.
cues.zh: 有幾種答案。

cues.en: For one thing, glue is still expensive, both in terms of computation time and also in terms of the number of flops, which corresponds to power requirements.
cues.zh: 首先，GELU 仍然昂貴，不論計算時間，或 FLOPs，也就是與耗電需求相關的運算量。

cues.en: And that can be pretty significant to consider if you want to run a model on, let's say, a phone or some other small device.
cues.zh: 如果想在手機等小型裝置執行模型，這點可能很重要。

cues.en: And also the optimizations are mostly for the GPU and not for the CPU as you saw.
cues.zh: 而且，最佳化大多針對 GPU，不是 CPU，如剛才看到。

cues.en: Furthermore, it's not so easy to change the activation function of an existing model, you would actually need to retrain the entire model.
cues.zh: 此外，既有模型不容易換活化函式，得重新訓練整個模型，

cues.en: And there's no guarantee that changing the model will give the same results that you had before.
cues.zh: 也不保證換了之後，結果相同。

cues.en: So if you already have, let's say, a vision recognition model that works really well, changing it
cues.zh: 如果已有表現很好的視覺辨識模型，

cues.en: just to use Galew instead of ReLU can be expensive, time consuming, and it's not clear if it's really going to be beneficial.
cues.zh: 只為了 GELU 取代 ReLU 而修改，可能昂貴、費時，也不確定有益。

cues.en: Also, one interesting feature is that because ReLU zeros out a lot of activations, it actually promotes sparsity in the model.
cues.zh: 另一個特性，是 ReLU 把許多活化設為 0，促進稀疏性，

cues.en: And that has proven useful for computer vision models that learn sparse filter kernels.
cues.zh: 對學習稀疏濾波核心的電腦視覺模型，已證明有幫助。

cues.en: So that means that just because the ReLU function seems to improve performance for large language models,
cues.zh: 所以，即使 GELU 似乎改善大型語言模型，

cues.en: it doesn't mean that a performance boost would necessarily be seen for any other kind of model.
cues.zh: 也不代表其他任何模型，都必然提升。

cues.en: Finally, it does seem like the improvement is fairly subtle, which means it's really only going to show up for extremely large and very deep models.
cues.zh: 最後，改善似乎相當細微，只有極大、極深模型，才看得出。

cues.en: Of course, all that said, what I'm writing here on this slide is just kind of this generally true
cues.zh: 不過，這張投影片的說法，只是目前大致情況，

cues.en: for now, but there's no reason to assume that ReLU is, or even should be the dominant activation function going into the future.
cues.zh: 沒有理由假設，未來 ReLU 仍然，或應該主導。

cues.en: There are practical engineering improvements in GPU hardware and implementations, and there are also theoretical developments in activation functions and learning.
